name: Beijing
description: China's medical capital with the highest concentration of top-tier hospitals. Leading in oncology, orthopedics, and neurology.

name: Shanghai
description: China's most international city with a vibrant expat community. Many hospitals with long histories of serving foreign patients.

name: Guangzhou
description: Southern China's medical hub, known for ENT (ear, nose, throat). Located near Hong Kong with strong international services.

name: Hainan
description: China's tropical island province with special medical tourism policies. Known for wellness, rehabilitation, and cosmetic surgery.
